name: Billing Config · Atlas budget (UX team)
task:
You are a project manager overseeing the development and operation of a new online platform, 'Atlas'. Your team uses cloud services to support the project.

The company has allocated a maximum monthly cloud spending limit of $1,000. However, your team aims to keep its monthly spending at $800 or less across all cloud services that generate costs. While spending more than $800 is permitted, your goal is to stay within this target.
Recently, cloud spending has regularly exceeded the expected amount and occasionally reached the $1000 limit, raising concerns about unexpected costs. Your manager has asked you to set up a monthly budget and alert based on actual spending, helping the team to take action early and prevent potential overspending.
You are told that the team prefers that budget notifications go directly to the project owners rather than other users.
Based on this situation, create a project and configure an appropriate monthly budget and spending alerts for the Atlas project.
start: The test starts on Budgets & Alerts Created (https://shiningcao77.github.io/Billing_Config/).
note: Drafted from a recording by sue/draft.py and confirmed in the platform.
screenSize: 1440x900 window; the task bar takes 56 px.
org: Alex Kim is a project manager managing cloud resources and financial limits for the Atlas platform.
checks: A monthly budget named 'Atlas monthly budget' is created for the Atlas project.
Budget target amount is set to $1,000.
An alert threshold is set at 80% ($800) actual spend.
Notifications are configured to email project owners.

steps.action: Navigate from console home through Billing to Budgets & caps
Click Create Budget, name the budget, and advance to scope
Set the budget time range to Monthly, select the Atlas project, and proceed
steps.defaults: Time range must be set to Monthly; Project must be scoped to Atlas rather than all projects

steps.action: Set the target budget amount to 1000 and advance to actions
Set the first threshold to 80% ($800), enable alerts to project owners, and finish
steps.defaults: Default threshold 1 is 50%; Email alerts to project owners is unchecked by default

success.name: Monthly, Atlas only, alerts to project owners only
Amount and alert fit the $800 target ($1,000 with a rule at 80% of actual spend, or $800 with a rule at 100%)
All services and a specified amount (in the prototype, no service ticked means all)

engine.gradingNote: Success criteria of the UX team's Test Procedure (section 10, received 2026-10-27): Monthly; Atlas project only; all services; specified amount; $1,000 with a rule at 80% of actual spend, or $800 with a rule at 100%; email alerts to project owners on, to billing admins and users off. Both count, whatever other alert rules stay: the default 50%, 90% and 100% rules may remain, and $800 with the default 100% rule untouched passes (decided 2026-10-27; Stephen wants more than one right outcome).
